_note: Colorways seed dataset. Desk research from 2026-10-31. Quotes come from search-result excerpts of the cited pages (pages could not be opened from the research environment), so spot-check each quote on the page before publishing. Hex values marked Described are Colorways approximations of colors named in the cited text, checked to fall in the named color family. Nothing here is a measurement yet. Spots are photo-worthy features (murals, stairs, carpets, bars, chandeliers); motifs are recurring color or material pairings.

hotels.name: Fontainebleau Las Vegas
